paragraphs: R' Yirmeyah son of R' Elai.
He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of chapter 11, and the statement has its source in Sanhedrin, end of chapter 4, where it appears without the name of the one who said it.[^1]

notes.text: ויק״ר רפ״יא and סנהדרין ספ״ד give Vayikra Rabbah beginning-of-chapter 11 and Sanhedrin end-of-chapter 4. They are chapter positions, not daf numbers; Sanhedrin’s corpus and the particular statement are not further identified or independently checked. Without-the-speaker’s-name remains Hyman’s report, not new exhaustive absence. Both personal title components remain R'.
